messages:
maya: Ran a multi-region sweep for the continuous-batcher tuning today. Goal: understand sensitivity of throughput/latency to batch_window_ms and max_batch_tokens across GPUs/regions. configs: window_ms=[10,30,60], max_tokens=[512,2048,8192], tilt=0.35.

josh: Nice. Which regions/instance types?

maya: us-west1 (H100), eu-west1 (A100 80GB), ap-northeast1 (L4). kernel selection = auto (cuBLASLt preferred on H100), kv_cache=on. used stable request mix: short-chat (avg 120 tokens) + long-gen (avg 2.2k tokens) at 70/30 split.

priya: TL;DR numbers? p50/p95 and tokens/s? :bar_chart:

maya: pasted raw summary below (tokens/sec per GPU replica, p95 latency ms for tail user requests):

```
Config: window_ms=10, max_tokens=512
- H100(us-west1): throughput=18.2k tok/s, p95=82ms, mem headroom=24%
- A100(eu-west1): throughput=12.9k tok/s, p95=110ms, mem headroom=18%
- L4(ap-northeast1): throughput=6.4k tok/s, p95=220ms, mem headroom=9%
\nConfig: window_ms=30, max_tokens=2048
- H100: throughput=26.7k tok/s, p95=120ms, mem headroom=8% (occasional OOM on peak long-gen)
- A100: throughput=19.3k tok/s, p95=165ms, mem headroom=5% (some kernel fallback observed)
- L4: throughput=8.9k tok/s, p95=380ms, mem headroom=1% (not recommended for long-gen)
\nConfig: window_ms=60, max_tokens=8192
- H100: throughput=28.4k tok/s, p95=340ms, mem headroom~0% (steady KV reuse but much higher tail)
- A100: throughput=20.1k tok/s, p95=480ms, mem headroom negative (spills -> big latency variance)
- L4: dropped requests on long-gen, unstable
```
\nNotes: cost-per-1M-tokens estimate (rough): H100 ~ $45, A100 ~ $62, L4 ~ $18 (but L4 poor for long sequences).
\nliam: Interesting that H100 gets best throughput but p95 jumps with a 60ms window -> seems batching long sequences increases tail. Did you try tilt adjustments (fairness) to protect short-chat?

maya: Yes — ran tilt sweep (0.0, 0.25, 0.5). With tilt=0.5 (weighted for short requests) p95 for short-chat dropped ~35% with throughput ~15% lower overall. Example: window_ms=30, max_tokens=2048, tilt=0.5 on H100 -> throughput 22.8k tok/s, short-chat p95=78ms, long-gen p95=210ms.

priya: Any kernel fallbacks that explain A100 variance? Logs?

maya: A100 showed more frequent kernel fallback to reference kernels when sequence>3k and quant path enabled. Kernel selector switches after memory pressure -> I/O spike. I captured deploybot warnings:

infra-bot: [deploybot] NOTE: A100-eu-west1 kernel_fallback_count=37 over run, fallback_reason=workspace_overflow

maya: Also saw small perf diff between cuBLASLt and our custom matmul on L4 for small batches. L4 prefers the custom tiled kernel for <=512 tokens.

liam: Good catch. So recommended defaults?

maya: Proposal for next rollout defaults (hosted):
- default window_ms=30, max_batch_tokens=2048, tilt=0.35 global
- per-region overrides: L4-regions -> window_ms=10, max_batch_tokens=512, enable aggressive eviction
- H100 large-models -> allow max_tokens=8192 but with tilt>=0.25 to protect short requests
- Kernel policy: prefer cuBLASLt on H100/A100, force custom tiled on L4 for small sequences

priya: +1. Can we add a safety valve to drop long requests to a slow-path (non-batched) when mem headroom <5%? That might avoid OOM/fallback spikes.

maya: Yep added to backlog: SAFE_PATH_ON_LOW_HEADROOM. Also planning a short A/B with tilt default change for 24h next week.

josh: Can you attach the CSV and perf plots? I'll run a capacity-sizing calc for committed pools.

maya: CSV uploaded to drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/cont-batch-sweep-1768754321.csv and lightweight plot gist: https://gist.internal/cont-batch-plots-1768754321.png

liam: For capacity planning, assume 75% of peak tokens from short-chat; use H100 configs with window_ms=30 as baseline. I'll sync with sales on pricing impact.

priya: One more ask: add evals to ensure quality not regressing when tilt changes (prompt-level outputs). If latency improvements break hallucination patterns we reject.

maya: Agreed — will run eval suite (20k prompts sampled) under tilt=0.35 vs tilt=0.5 and post results here.

josh: Thanks all. Short action list: (1) add SAFE_PATH_ON_LOW_HEADROOM, (2) A/B tilt default, (3) per-region L4 conservative defaults, (4) run quality evals.

maya: filing tasks now. cc @liam @priya. :white_check_mark:
